mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand and economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the signal is active.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within 3 months signals increased supply-side capacity, which can lead to overproduction and reduced profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer demand and a healthy labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand and healthy labor market
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% within 3 months signals deflationary pressure, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially in a regime of low inflation.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the signal is active and inflation is low.
